title: The icon bar is shown for some seconds when the render window opens
author: Claude-JG
description: A new user does not know that the icon bar folds in at the right border of the render window. Decided: the bar is shown when the window opens and folds out after general.iconBarStartTime milliseconds, default 5000; it is drawn after the frame is saved, so it is not on saved or raytraced images.
releaseNotes: The icon bar is shown for visualizationSettings.general.iconBarStartTime milliseconds, 5000 by default, when the render window opens, so that a new user sees where it is; it is not on saved or raytraced images.
